purpose: Deterministic child-side JSON boundary for Chalk formatting; this is not a Harbor bundle or a candidate CLI requirement.

transport.request: one JSON object per line on stdin
transport.response: one JSON object per line on stdout
transport.stderr: diagnostics only; never parsed as a result

request.json_value: null, boolean, finite number, string, array, or plain object recursively

format.chain: non-empty array of {name: string, args: JSON array}; zero-argument style names use args=[]
format.style_names: the names exported by modifierNames, foregroundColorNames, backgroundColorNames, underlineColorNames, plus visible and the nine color-model builders
format.values: JSON values converted by the package's ordinary JavaScript String semantics and joined with one ASCII space

inventory.result: exported style-name arrays and aliases; support metadata is only included from an isolated launch

detect-support.environment: complete allowlisted environment map supplied before child launch
detect-support.argv: complete allowlisted argv vector supplied before module import

success.value: string, JSON array, JSON object, or false according to operation

failure.message: stable bounded message without paths, stacks, timestamps, or environment dumps

determinism.ansi: preserved in text when explicit level is greater than zero; level zero emits no style escapes
determinism.line_endings: Chalk preserves input LF and CRLF; JSONL adds only its response delimiter
